% ============================================================
%     PROFILE STATEMENT
% ============================================================

\vspace{6pt}
\small{Software developer working on production courier logistics and warehouse systems. Primary author of five subsystems in a .NET 8 courier platform handling orders, waybills, manifests, proof of delivery and billing across seven integrated courier partners. Strong in C\#, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, with React and TypeScript on the frontend, deployed on Azure. Particular focus on query optimisation and on fixing performance problems in live systems.}

\section{Core Competencies}
\vspace{1pt}
\begin{itemize}

\item \textbf{Languages}: C\#, SQL, TypeScript, JavaScript.

\item \textbf{Frameworks}: .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core 8, LINQ, React, Clean Architecture.

\item \textbf{Databases and caching}: Microsoft SQL Server, Redis (StackExchange.Redis), MongoDB.

\item \textbf{Cloud and tooling}: Microsoft Azure (Blob Storage, File Shares, SignalR), Application Insights, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Git, REST APIs.

\item \textbf{Domain}: Courier and logistics systems (orders, waybills, manifests, proof of delivery, billing), warehouse management inbound processes, production performance debugging.

\item \textbf{Exposure}: Python, FastAPI, Azure OpenAI, RAG pipelines.

% ============================================================

\section{Professional Experience}
\vspace{3pt}
\begin{itemize}

\needspace{5\baselineskip}
\item{\cventry{2025-Present}{Junior Software Developer}{Nucleus Supply Chain}{Sandton, Johannesburg}{}{\vspace{1pt}
\begin{itemize}
    \item Primary author of the proof-of-delivery, customer service desk, manifest, notification and configuration subsystems of the company's courier logistics platform (.NET 8, Entity Framework Core 8, SQL Server, Redis, Azure), a platform spanning 76 entities and 246 API endpoints across 39 controllers.
    \item Merged over 40 pull requests into a 37,000-line production codebase serving seven integrated courier partners.
    \item Rewrote the manifest view data access to replace per-manifest and per-order lookups with a single SQL JOIN, reducing an O(orders) query pattern to one query using EF Core projection and \texttt{AsNoTracking()}.
    \item Traced 30-second request delays to a Redis client timeout misconfiguration and corrected it, cutting the synchronous timeout from 15 seconds to 2 and removing the worst-case stall when the cache was slow or unavailable.
    \item Contributed to eliminating an N+1 query pattern on the order list, replacing up to 1,200 per-page database calls with three batched queries.
    \item Built the inbound processes of the company's separate warehouse management system from the ground up, working alongside the tech lead on the wider platform architecture.
    \item Diagnoses and resolves production defects on live client systems, frequently while courier and warehouse operations are still running.
\end{itemize}}}

\end{itemize}
